```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DiagrammeR)
```

# Simplified SEMs

```{r}
simple_model_objects <- readRDS(
  "infection-modeling/data/model-objects/simplified-SEM-objects.rds"
)

simple_out <- simple_model_objects$sem_mod$fit

## reformat the tables
simple_out$dTable <- simple_out$dTable %>%
  data.frame() %>% rename(sig = "Var.6") %>% tibble()
simple_out$coefficients <- simple_out$coefficients %>%
  data.frame() %>% rename(sig = "Var.9") %>% tibble()
```


```{r}
group_tiers <- c(
  "environment", "trait", "behavior", "parasitism", "expression", "infection"
)

group_cols <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(group_tiers) + 1, "Pastel2")[-2]

# group_cols <- c(
#   "green", "burlywood", "azure", "grey80", "darkorchid1", "hotpink1"
# )

var_table <- tibble(
  var = c(
    "expr_PC2", "Bb_infected", "expr_PC1", "ticks_attached", "capprop_shift",
    "cap_prop_night", "weight", "sex_mature", 
    "sex_male", "wthr_PC1", "clim_PC1"
  ),
  label = c(
    "Tolerance\nexpression", "Infection\nstatus", "Resistance\nexpression", "Parasitized\n(ticks)", "Capture\ntime shift", 
    "Capture\ntime", "Weight", "Reproductive\nmaturity", 
    "Sex", "Weather\nPC", "Climate\nPC"
  ),
  response = c(
    TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, 
    TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, 
    FALSE, FALSE, FALSE
  ),
  group = c(
    "expression", "infection", "expression", "parasitism", "behavior",
    "behavior", "trait", "trait", 
    "trait", "environment", "environment"
  ) %>% 
    factor(levels = group_tiers)
)
```


```{r, include = FALSE}
scales::pal_area(range = c(0, 1))

pos_col = "cornflowerblue"
neg_col = "orange"

effect_cols <- c(
  pos_col, colorspace::lighten(pos_col, 0.4), colorspace::lighten(pos_col, 0.8),
  neg_col, colorspace::lighten(neg_col, 0.4), colorspace::lighten(neg_col, 0.8)
)
  
# scales::show_col(effect_cols)
```

```{r}
paths <- simple_out$coefficients %>% 
  select(Response, Predictor, DF, Std.Estimate, P.Value) %>% 
  mutate(
    # pos_effect = Std.Estimate >= 0,
    Response = factor(
      Response, levels = var_table$var, labels = var_table$label
    ),
    Predictor = factor(
      Predictor, levels = var_table$var, labels = var_table$label
    ),
    color = if_else(Std.Estimate >= 0, pos_col, neg_col),
    penwidth = scales::rescale(x = abs(Std.Estimate) ,to = c(1, 9)),
    style = if_else(P.Value <= 0.1, "solid", "dashed")
    # headlabel = round(Std.Estimate, 2),
    # labelfontsize = 14
  )

nodes <- tibble(
  var = unique(
    c(simple_out$coefficients$Response, simple_out$coefficients$Predictor)
  )
) %>% 
  mutate(
    var = factor(var, levels = var_table$var, labels = var_table$label),
    id = row_number(),
    group = var_table$group[match(var, var_table$label)],
    # y = as.numeric(group),
    shape = "rectangle",
    fillcolor = group_cols[match(group, group_tiers)]
  )
```

```{r}
sem_graph <- create_graph(attr_theme = "bt") %>% 
  # add_global_graph_attrs("layout", "dot", "graph") %>%
  # add_global_graph_attrs("rankdir", "LR", "graph") %>%
  add_nodes_from_table(nodes, label_col = var) %>% 
  add_edges_from_table(
    paths, from_col = Predictor, to_col = Response, from_to_map = label
  ) %>% 
  set_node_attrs(width, 1.4) %>%
  set_node_attrs(height, .7) %>%
  set_node_attrs(fontsize, 16) %>%
  set_node_attrs(fontcolor, "black") %>% 
  set_node_attrs(color, "black")
  
sem_graph %>% render_graph() 
```

1. Quantify (add up) the effects of phenotype, weather, and behavior on 
infection. 

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# ## Possible to use `diagrammeR::get_paths(from = "sex_male", to = "infected")`?
# frm = "male"
# frm_id = path_nodes$id[match(frm, path_nodes$var)]
# to = "infected"
# to_id = path_nodes$id[match(to, path_nodes$var)]

from_id = nodes %>% filter(var == "Sex") %>% pull(id)
to_id = nodes %>% filter(var == "Infection\nstatus") %>% pull(id)


# get a list of all paths from sex to infected...
through_paths <- get_paths(sem_graph, from = from_id, to = to_id) %>% unique()
# logical varaible indicating direct path
is_direct = lapply(through_paths, function(x)length(x) == 2) %>% unlist()
dir_path = through_paths[is_direct] %>% unlist()
indir_paths = through_paths[!is_direct]


# convert numeric ids to names
name_paths <- lapply(
  through_paths, function(x)nodes$var[match(x, nodes$id)]
)

# go through a path
this <- rev(through_paths)[[1]] # longest path

path_effects <- vector("numeric")

for(i in seq_len(length(this) - 1)) {
  x = this[i]
  y = this[i + 1]
  
  var_x = nodes %>% filter(id == x) %>% pull(var)
  var_y = nodes %>% filter(id == y) %>% pull(var)
  
  eff <- paths %>% 
    filter(Predictor == var_x, Response == var_y) %>% 
    pull(Std.Estimate)
  
  path_effects <- append(effects, eff)
}

cum_path_efffect <- prod(path_effects)


```
